Determination: Adverse determination, medical necessity

NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION

Cascade Mutual has completed a medical necessity review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the clinical information submitted by the facility and the attending physician, the requested inpatient level of care does not meet the applicable medical necessity criteria. Payment for the inpatient admission billed under DRG 191 is denied.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODES
CARC CO-50
RARC N115

BASIS FOR DETERMINATION
The review was conducted using the MCG-style criteria set, edition in effect for the dates of service.

COPD-01: Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.
COPD-02: Work of breathing was not significantly increased.

Overall rationale: The services provided could have been delivered safely at a lower level of care, such as observation.

This determination applies to the medical necessity of the inpatient level of care only. It is not a statement that the care delivered was unnecessary, and it does not direct the treating provider's clinical judgment. The member is not financially liable for services denied under the codes cited above where provider contract terms apply.

APPEAL RIGHTS
You, your authorized representative, or your treating provider may request an appeal of this adverse determination. Submit a written appeal addressed to Utilization Management, Cascade Mutual. The appeal should reference the guideline code and the specific finding being contested for each argument raised, addressing COPD-01 and COPD-02 separately. Supporting documentation may include the admission history and physical, physician progress notes, nursing assessments, and respiratory therapy records for the period from [[ADMIT_DATE]] to [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].

A physician attestation line must be included and signed by the attending or reviewing physician.

Physician attestation: I attest that the clinical information submitted with this appeal is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge. ______________________________

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that time may not be accepted for review.

A peer-to-peer discussion with the reviewing physician may be requested by contacting Utilization Management at the number listed on the member identification card.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
